title: Enhanced 5mC-Methylation-Site Recognition in DNA Sequences using Token Classification and a Domain-specific Loss Function
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习预测DNA 5mC甲基化位点，虽涉及DNA序列与蛋白修饰相关，但非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无三维互作建模与机制研究，仅序列级分类任务。
abstract: DNA 5-methylcytosine modification has been widely studied in mammals and plays an important role in epigenetics. Several computational methods exist that attempt to determine the methylation state of a DNA sequence centered at a possible methylation site. Here, we introduce a novel deep-learning framework, MR-DNA, that predicts the methylation state of a single nucleotide located in a gene promoter region. The idea is to adapt the named-entity recognition approach to methylation-site prediction and to incorporate biological rules during model construction. MR-DNA has a stacked model architecture consisting of a pre-trained MuLan-Methyl-DistilBERT language model and a conditional random field algorithm, trained with a self-defined methyl loss function. The resulting fine-tuned model achieves an accuracy of 97.9% on an independent test dataset of samples. An advantage of this formulation of the methylation-site identification task is that it predicts on every nucleotide of a sequence of a given length, unlike previous methods that the predict methylation state of DNA sequences of a short fixed length. For training and testing purposes, we provide a database of DNA sequences containing verified 5mC-methylation sites, calculated from data for eight human cell lines downloaded from the ENCODE database.
abstract_zh: DNA 5-甲基胞嘧啶修饰在哺乳动物中已被广泛研究，并在表观遗传学中发挥重要作用。已有多种计算方法试图确定以潜在甲基化位点为中心的DNA序列的甲基化状态。在此，我们介绍一种新颖的深度学习框架MR-DNA，用于预测基因启动子区域中单个核苷酸的甲基化状态。其思路是将命名实体识别方法适应于甲基化位点预测，并在模型构建过程中融入生物学规则。MR-DNA采用堆叠模型架构，由预训练的MuLan-Methyl-DistilBERT语言模型和条件随机场算法组成，并使用自定义的甲基损失函数进行训练。所得到的微调模型在独立测试数据集上的准确率达到97.9%。该甲基化位点识别任务公式的一个优势在于，它能对给定长度的序列中的每个核苷酸进行预测，而以往方法仅能预测短固定长度DNA序列的甲基化状态。为训练和测试目的，我们提供了一个包含已验证5mC甲基化位点的DNA序列数据库，该数据库基于从ENCODE数据库下载的八种人类细胞系数据计算得出。
